! =====================================================
! BASIC / IDENTITY
! =====================================================
hostname [SW-ACCESS-01]
!
no ip domain lookup
ip domain name [example.local]
!
! =====================================================
! AAA — Cisco ISE (TACACS+) z lokalnym fallbackiem (break-glass only)
! =====================================================
username [breakglass-admin] privilege 15 secret [STRONG_SECRET]
!
aaa new-model
!
tacacs server [ISE-1]
 address ipv4 [10.x.x.x]
 key [TACACS_SHARED_SECRET]
!
aaa group server tacacs+ [ISE-TACACS]
 server name [ISE-1]
!
aaa authentication login default group [ISE-TACACS] local
aaa authentication enable default group [ISE-TACACS] enable
aaa authorization exec default group [ISE-TACACS] local if-authenticated
aaa authorization commands 15 default group [ISE-TACACS] local if-authenticated
aaa accounting exec default start-stop group [ISE-TACACS]
aaa accounting commands 15 default start-stop group [ISE-TACACS]
!
! =====================================================
! MANAGEMENT — SSH only (zgodnie z constraints.md), VRF MGMT
! =====================================================
vrf definition [MGMT]
 address-family ipv4
 exit-address-family
!
interface Vlan[100]
 description MGMT
 vrf forwarding [MGMT]
 ip address [10.100.0.10] [255.255.255.0]
 no shutdown
!
ip route vrf [MGMT] 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 [10.100.0.1]
!
crypto key generate rsa modulus 4096
ip ssh version 2
ip ssh time-out 60
ip ssh authentication-retries 3
!
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
 exec-timeout 10 0
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 10 0
 logging synchronous
!
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
!
! =====================================================
! NTP — CORE SW jako źródło czasu (zgodnie z network_env.md 3.3)
! =====================================================
ntp server [CORE_SW_IP_1] prefer
ntp server [CORE_SW_IP_2]
clock timezone [UTC] 0
!
! =====================================================
! LOGGING — syslog do systemu monitoringu (WhatsUp Gold / Prime)
! =====================================================
logging buffered 64000 informational
logging host [LOG_SYSTEM_IP] vrf [MGMT]
logging source-interface Vlan[100] vrf [MGMT]
logging trap informational
service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone
service timestamps debug datetime msec localtime show-timezone
!
snmp-server community [RO_COMMUNITY] RO [SNMP_ACL]
snmp-server location [BUILDING/FLOOR/ROOM]
snmp-server contact [NETOPS_CONTACT]
!
! =====================================================
! VLANS (przykładowe — uzupełnij wg planu adresacji)
! =====================================================
vlan [10]
 name [DATA]
vlan [20]
 name [VOICE]
vlan [30]
 name [WIFI-AP]
vlan [100]
 name [MGMT]
vlan [999]
 name [BLACKHOLE]
!
! =====================================================
! GLOBAL L2 SECURITY
! =====================================================
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default
spanning-tree extend system-id
!
ip dhcp snooping
ip dhcp snooping vlan [10,20,30]
no ip dhcp snooping information option
!
errdisable recovery cause bpduguard
errdisable recovery cause psecure-violation
errdisable recovery interval 300
!
vtp mode transparent
!

! =====================================================
! UPLINK — trunk do dystrybucji (C9500)
! =====================================================
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/1
 description UPLINK-[DISTRO-SW]
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan [10,20,30,100]
 switchport nonegotiate
 ip dhcp snooping trust
 channel-group 1 mode active
!
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/1/2
 description UPLINK-[DISTRO-SW]
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan [10,20,30,100]
 switchport nonegotiate
 ip dhcp snooping trust
 channel-group 1 mode active
!
!
interface Port-channel1
 description PO1-UPLINK-[DISTRO-SW]
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan [10,20,30,100]
!
! =====================================================
! MISC HARDENING
! =====================================================
service password-encryption
no service pad
banner motd ^
[AUTHORIZED ACCESS ONLY — organizacyjny banner prawny]
^
!
end
